title: Best robot vacuum deal: Ecovacs Deebot X12S is $300 Off
excerpt: 97% fewer dust mites, 100% less vacuuming on a Sunday.
content_html:
SAVE $300: Ecovacs' new flagship, the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone, is certified to remove 97% of dust mite allergens from the carpet. It self-washes, self-empties, and mops with fresh water — and it's $999.99 right now, 23% off its $1,299.99 list price.

Credit: Ecovacs

$999.99 at Amazon
$1,299.99 Save $300

If you've been circling a robot vacuum purchase and waiting for a "real" discount to pull the trigger, this is it. Ecovacs just dropped its brand-new flagship, the Deebot X12S OmniCyclone, available for $999.99, down from its $1,299.99 list price. That's obviously the lowest price this model has been since it debuted. 

If you've got carpet, pets, or a dust mite allergy you've made peace with, this is the moment to stop scrolling and finally buy the thing. Most robot vacuums glide over your carpet and grab whatever's sitting on top. The X12S actually digs in. It's built with a sealed chamber specifically for extracting dust mite allergens from carpet fibers, and it's been independently tested (SGS-certified) to remove an average of 97.44% of them. 

Credit: Ecovacs

And instead of dragging a damp pad around and smearing dirty water everywhere, it feeds itself fresh water through 32 tiny outlets while a built-in scraper wipes the dirty water away in real-time — so you're not redistributing grime across your kitchen floor. It also pre-treats sticky, dried-on messes before it even starts scrubbing.

The suction is rated at 53AW, which means it's got enough pull to lift pet hair and debris rather than just push it around. And it's built to stop hair from wrapping around the brushes, which is the main reason robot vacuums die early.

The smartest part, though, might be how it handles carpet versus hard floor in the same run. When it senses a carpet, it lifts the wet mop roller and covers it, so it doesn't drag a damp pad across your rug and leave it soggy. It also charges itself every time it stops to wash its own roller, so a routine maintenance break doubles as a mini recharge.

When it's done, it handles its own cleanup: no dust bags, no wringing out a mop — the base station empties the bin, washes the roller in hot water, dries it with hot air, and cleans itself. 

Grab the flagship Ecovacs robot vacuum while it’s $300 off at Amazon.
